titre.sous: depend on, interested in, responsible for

idee.titre: No logic: learn them as one block

etapes.texte: Some verbs and adjectives **always take the same preposition**
You cannot guess it from your own language
Learn the pair, not the single word

q.lu: Ms. Park is **responsible** ------- training new staff.

etapes.texte: Look at the word **just before** the blank
Ask: which preposition **always** follows this word?
After the preposition, the verb takes __-ing__

phrases.texte: Some verbs and adjectives always take the same preposition.
There is no logic, and you cannot guess it from your own language. So learn the pair, not the single word.
Here are the favourite verbs of the TOEIC. Depend on. Apply for.
And the favourite adjectives. Responsible for. Interested in.
Now, a TOEIC question. Ms. Park is responsible, blank, training new staff.
phrases.dit: Now, a TOEIC question. Miz Park is responsible, blank, training new staff.

phrases.texte: A: of. B: for. C: to. D: with.
phrases.dit: Answer A. of. Answer B. for. Answer C. to. Answer D. with.

phrases.texte: Look at the word just before the blank: responsible. It always takes for.
phrases.dit: Look at the word just before the blank: responsible. It always takes, for.

phrases.texte: So A, C and D are wrong.
phrases.dit: So A, C, and D are wrong.

phrases.texte: B is correct: Ms. Park is responsible for training new staff. And notice training: after a preposition, the verb takes -ing.
phrases.dit: B is correct: Miz Park is responsible for training new staff. And notice, training: after a preposition, the verb takes ing.

phrases.texte: Three steps. One: look at the word just before the blank.
Two: ask which preposition always follows this word.
Three: after the preposition, the verb takes -ing.
phrases.dit: Three: after the preposition, the verb takes ing.

phrases.texte: Now practise with the questions below.
phrases.dit: Now, practise with the questions below.
